notes.title: Updates for version 1.0.2b
notes.content:
Changelog - Version 1.0.2b
New Features
Blocked Yellow Spheres Visual Indicator: When a yellow sphere becomes blocked, an "X" mark will now appear on top of it for clearer visual feedback.

notes.title: July 2025 Updates
notes.content:
Changelog - Version 1.0.2a
This update focuses on polishing the user experience and fixing minor issues.

Fixed
Pause Menu Input: Addressed an issue where input continued to be registered while the game was paused, preventing unintended actions.

Level Configuration: Resolved minor inconsistencies and bugs in various level configurations.

Localization/Labels: Corrected errors in several in-game text labels and tags.

notes.title: Updates Notes for 1.0.2
notes.content:
📌 Changelog - Version 1.0.2
General Improvements:

🚀 Increased character speed: The character's base movement speed has been increased to enhance game flow and responsiveness.

Visual Effects:

🎬 New visual effect - Movie Grain: A cinematic movie grain effect has been added to give the game a more atmospheric and stylized look.

⏪ Improved rewind visuals: Visual and transition effects during rewind sequences have been polished for a smoother and more immersive experience.

Bug Fixes:

🪲 Step count correction: Fixed an issue where steps were incorrectly penalized when performing a rewind. Step count now accurately reflects player progress.
